input: All6Train27251frame actual detector proposal banks, current-frame Hungarian GT labels and unchanged descriptor reliability. Never crop using GT or read Dev/Test labels.
fit: Known positive reliable actual detections in first75% of each Train video;minimum3 observations per video-local identity. Fit independent RGB-only512D and paired1024D regularized Fisher transforms, equal video/identity weights. No old Fisher coefficients reused.
legacy_difference: Old Fisher used sampled GT boxes pooled from320D teacher FPN. This investigation reuses actual detector boxes and512D independently trained ReID crop encoders. The classical Fisher algorithm itself is not novel.
validation: 6 deterministic leave-one-Train-video-out transform fits. Only other5videos early observations enter a transform. Held video's first3 reliable early detections per GT identity form diagnostic templates;last25% reliable known positives are queries. Encoder pretraining previously saw all Train identities, including held video:exclusion applies only to the projection.

progress_gates.RGB: ProjectedRGB minus rawRGB equal-video top1>=2absolute points and wins on at least4of6heldTrain videos
progress_gates.paired: Projectedpaired minus projectedRGB equal-video top1>=1absolute point and wins on at least4of6heldTrain videos
progress_gates.on_failure: Retain negative diagnostic;do not promote it to Dev or tracking contribution. Continue investigating identity dynamics or recognition using Train evidence.

next_if_gate_passes: Refit a separately calibrated logical ledger on transformed allTrain candidates,then completeDev before any newTest. Preserve matchedRGB,missingIR and current-frame IR permutation;do not reuse raw-ledger probability calibration.
